name: Nimble
description:
Your base speed is doubled, but you start each turn with no actions. You may convert movement into actions at a rate of 10 ft per half action, spending as much movement as you like each turn.

Additionally, your jump distance and height are doubled, you can run up vertical surfaces up to 1/4 your speed as if it were flat ground, and you take no damage from falling up to 1/4 your speed if all your limbs are free.

improvements.name: Hard To Pin Down
improvements.description: You may also convert movement into engagement dice at a rate of 1d4 per 10 ft.

improvements.name: Ready To Spring
improvements.description: You may spend half your movement to force all foes who make melee attacks against you until your next turn to roll Dexterity vs Dexterity instead of engagement.

improvements.name: Like The Wind
improvements.description: Your base speed is tripled instead of doubled.
